fusions.name: Nutcracker Blow
fusions.desc: Cracks the target with a held stone for 30 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Two-Fisted Pounding
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground with both fists, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Find the Soft Spot
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 35% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Knows Where It Cracks
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour. It also reduces the cooldown of every other ability you have by 5%.
